name: Saimin Appli Megutai Jimiko wa Ore no Koibito
original_name: 催眠アプリ恵体地味娘は俺の恋人
source:
A simulation game where you hypnotize your plain but busty classmate into thinking you are her lover, and make her have sex with you.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE270081.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE270081.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
